 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"ameliorate"** means to make something better or improve a situation. (सुधारना)
 
 
• **Example: **The government took several measures to ameliorate the living conditions of the poor.
 
 
 
• **"Exacerbate"** refers to making a bad situation worse. (बिगाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **The heavy rains exacerbated the flooding problem in the city.
